neighbours.label: describing the aesthetic effect or finish an item gives a look or decor ('gives the blouse a feminine finish', 'makes the outfit look complete')
fire: A pair of gold earrings will make the dress look polished.
The brass handles give the cabinet an elegant finish.
Fresh flowers can brighten your dining room's atmosphere.
A leather belt makes the whole outfit feel finished.
The velvet trim lends the jacket a luxurious touch.
Painted beams give the cottage kitchen a rustic charm.
A bold rug can transform a plain hallway into a statement.
Without the hat, the costume would not look complete.
quiet: A pair of gold earrings was found under the dresser.
The brass handles were ordered from a supplier in March.
Fresh flowers are delivered to the dining room on Fridays.
A leather belt costs about thirty dollars at the market.
The velvet jacket was cleaned at the shop last week.
Painted beams were installed in the cottage last summer.
A bold rug arrived in the hallway in a large box.
Without the hat, she walked home in the cold rain.
